description: This line plot illustrates the relationship between initial confidence and three accuracy metrics—final accuracy, change in accuracy (Δ Accuracy), and initial accuracy—for LLMs under feedback friction. The x-axis represents “Initial Confidence,” ranging from 0.86 to 1.00 in linear scale with tick labels spaced at intervals of 0.02. The y-axis represents “Accuracy,” scaled linearly from 0.0 to 1.0. The “Final Accuracy” is shown as a solid blue line with circular markers, remaining consistently high across the range, starting at approximately 0.95 and ending near 0.99. The “Initial Accuracy” is depicted as a dashed green line with square markers, starting at about 0.65, peaking near 0.90, and declining to around 0.75. The “Δ Accuracy” is represented by a dashed orange line with diamond markers, beginning near 0.30, decreasing to a low of approximately 0.05, and then rising slightly toward the end of the range.
